items.chunk: guaranteed to work or your money back
items.meaning: 保证有效，否则退款；广告措辞
items.quote: Best of all, it's guaranteed to work or your money back.

items.meaning: 取得某人的信任
items.quote: Gus: Gain his confidence. Make him rely on you.

items.meaning: 让某人依赖你
items.quote: Gus: Gain his confidence. Make him rely on you.

items.chunk: Let me see if I have this right.
items.meaning: 让我确认一下我是不是理解对了
items.quote: Saul: Yeah. Uh-huh. Sure. Ahem. Let me see if I have this right.

items.meaning: 像平常一样；此处称对方判断一贯正确
items.quote: You were right, as usual.

items.chunk: Can you hold for a moment?
items.meaning: 请稍等别挂电话好吗？
items.quote: Can you hold for a moment? Kim, how about dinner and a movie tonight?

items.meaning: 得看情况；不马上答应
items.quote: I love that one, but, um, we'll have to see.

items.meaning: 加班留到较晚
items.quote: I might need to stay late.

items.meaning: 看看也无妨；降低尝试门槛
items.quote: Maybe not today, but doesn't hurt to look, does it?

items.meaning: 签到、登记到访
items.quote: Hey, folks. Do you mind signing in?

items.meaning: 随便看看这里；接待
items.quote: Just take your time. Have a look around. Let me know if you have any questions.

items.meaning: 把地方布置成自己的风格
items.quote: Hey, this would be a big change, but we could make it our own.

items.meaning: 话不小心脱口而出
items.quote: I, uh, told a few potential clients. It just kind of slipped out.

items.meaning: 愚蠢的举动；随意贬义
items.quote: But it was a bonehead move and I shouldn't have done it.

items.meaning: 梦寐以求的某物
items.quote: - This is the closet of your dreams. - Our dreams.

items.chunk: be on sb.'s feet all day
items.meaning: 一整天站着／跑来跑去
items.quote: That would be so nice after a long day on our feet.
items.original_chunk: be on one's feet all day

items.chunk: Is that what I think it is?
items.meaning: 那就是我想的那个东西吗？；惊讶确认
items.quote: - Whoa. - Yeah. Is that what I think it is?

items.chunk: I'll make sure sb. does sth.
items.meaning: 我会确保某人做某事；承诺
items.quote: - Thanks. I'll make sure he drinks it. - Thank you.

items.meaning: 根本不在乎；粗俗
items.quote: They don't give a shit. As long as he makes them cash.

items.meaning: 临时被叫去上班
items.quote: Well, I just got called in.

items.meaning: 用好听话哄某人
items.quote: She needs to finish her homework first. Don't let her sweet-talk you.

items.meaning: 那绝不可能；笃定否认
items.quote: No, not a chance of that.

items.chunk: You know more than you think you know.
items.meaning: 你知道的比你自己以为的多；鼓励
items.quote: I bet you know more than you think you know.

items.meaning: 咱们进行到哪一步了？；口语状态确认
items.quote: It's a big game. Where are we at?

items.chunk: go back and forth between sth. and sth.
items.meaning: 在两个选择之间反复摇摆
items.quote: You know, I think he went back and forth between an astronaut, deep sea explorer like Jacques cousteau.

items.meaning: 弄得一团糟
items.quote: No, you're not! You're making a mess.

items.chunk: Either do it right, or don't do it.
items.meaning: 要么好好做，要么别做；严厉要求
items.quote: You either do it right, or you don't do it.

items.meaning: 你说谁是……？；被称呼冒犯后反问
items.quote: Who you calling "fool," fool?

items.meaning: 别逼我做某事；警告对方
items.quote: Don't make me come down there.

items.meaning: 去吧；让对方出发／行动
items.quote: Off you go, ocho loco.

items.meaning: 被警方抓走；此处不是接送
items.quote: - Only domingo got picked up? - Yeah.

items.meaning: 把一个地方翻个底朝天
items.quote: These assholes will turn the whole place upside-down.

items.meaning: 有共同点
items.quote: Suzanne, I think we have something in common.

items.meaning: 没希望挽救的人／事
items.quote: Leder? Lost cause.

items.meaning: 我不敢苟同；礼貌而明确反对
items.quote: - Ah, I beg to differ. - He assaulted a minor.

items.meaning: 不接受；拒绝提议的口语回应
items.quote: No sale. Leder's doing the full freight.

items.meaning: 承担全部刑罚／付出全部代价；此处指坐满刑期
items.quote: No sale. Leder's doing the full freight.

items.meaning: 某事有什么消息／进展？
items.quote: Hey. What's the word on moving Tripp to Thursday?

items.meaning: 把金属饰品／穿孔饰品摘掉；lose在指令中为去掉，hardware为口语戏称饰物
items.quote: Pull your hair back and lose the hardware.

items.chunk: Into every life, a little rain must fall.
items.meaning: 人生难免不如意；引语式安慰，较书面
items.quote: - But it's gonna close up. - Into every life, a little rain must fall.

items.chunk: What say you to doing sth.?
items.meaning: 你觉得做某事怎么样？；较旧／诙谐提议
items.quote: Mitch! Uh, what say you to moving Tripp to Thursday?

items.meaning: 挺身而出、主动站出来
items.quote: What can I say? People step up.

items.meaning: 我们有什么资格评判？
items.quote: Life's rich pageant, who are we to judge?

items.meaning: 这就对了／要的就是这个态度
items.quote: That's the spirit.

items.meaning: 重新开始原来的工作／回到岗位
items.quote: - You're back in the saddle. - Yeah.

items.chunk: Any chance you're available for sth.?
items.meaning: 你有没有可能有空做某事？；试探邀请
items.quote: I was wondering, any chance you're available for lunch some time?

items.meaning: 我的号码在电话簿上；依赖旧电话簿语境
items.quote: Yeah. Have Julie call my people. I'm in the book. See you, Howard.

items.chunk: to the tune of + 数额
items.meaning: 数量竟达……；强调数额
items.quote: To the tune of 16 cases.

items.meaning: 快速大量地处理／消耗；此处讽刺只求客户周转
items.quote: You wanna churn through more clients, make more money.

items.meaning: 坐过牢／在监狱里；犯罪口语
items.quote: Has he ever been inside before?

items.meaning: 让某人为某事做好准备；prep是prepare口语简写
items.quote: So we can prep him for the deposition.

items.meaning: 用吃东西排解情绪
items.quote: The guy eats his feelings.

items.meaning: 电话要断／听不到你了；通话信号语境
items.quote: Look, I'm in an elevator. Now I'm gonna lose you.

items.meaning: 还得等一阵；口语，不一定字面一分钟
items.quote: It's gonna be a minute.

items.meaning: 已经包含／已经算在内
items.quote: That's already baked in.

items.meaning: 你尽管试试做某事吧；此处讽刺很难成功，不是祝福
items.quote: So, you know, good luck finding a jury that's never been reamed out by a relative.

items.meaning: 被狠狠训斥；随意口语
items.quote: that's never been reamed out by a relative.

items.meaning: 恶作剧出了岔子
items.quote: Well, it was more of a prank gone wrong.

items.meaning: 合作愉快；交易结束套语
items.quote: Pleasure doing business with you.

items.meaning: 回头见；较旧俚语，也常见flip side
items.quote: Catch you on the flip-flop.

items.meaning: 某事轻而易举
items.quote: Seventy hours is a breeze, trust me.

items.meaning: 我得赶紧走／挂电话了；随意口语
items.quote: Bruno, good talking to you. I gotta jump.

items.meaning: 我有个大好消息！；强调倒装，不是疑问
items.quote: Hey, have I got good news.

items.meaning: 好久不见
items.quote: Mr varga, long time no see.
